title: Watermelon Harvest: From Seed to Table
reason: The video describes the journey of watermelon cultivation from seed to table, highlighting various farming practices.

tasks.task: Explain the process of planting watermelon seeds and nurturing the young plants.

subtasks.text: Observe the emergence of green shoots from the tiny watermelon seeds.

The scene transitions from the initial planting phase to the early stages of growth, where the focus shifts to observing the emergence of the first green shoots from the planted seeds.

- The robot must have the capability to analyze images to identify plant growth.
